ios.desc:
Summarize it all in one tap.

Sumr turns webpages, PDFs, YouTube videos, supported social videos, and shared text into clear summaries. Use it from Safari, the Share Sheet, or Shortcuts, then keep every result in one searchable library.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Share content from Safari, Chrome, Files, Mail, Notes, and other apps
• Run Summarize Text from Shortcuts or Siri and pass the result into your next action
• Summarize webpages, PDFs, YouTube videos, and supported social videos
• Ask follow-up questions without leaving the summary
• Customize the tone, structure, and focus with your own prompt
• Search and filter saved summaries by content type
• Export selected summaries or your full library as Markdown
• Back up and restore your summary library
• Choose your summary language independently of the source

CHOOSE HOW YOU USE AI

On supported devices, Apple Intelligence can summarize privately on device, even offline, without an API key or Sumr quota. You can also use Sumr's built-in service or bring your own API key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, xAI, or an OpenAI-compatible provider. Bringing your own key does not require a Sumr subscription.

SUMR PREMIUM

Annual, Monthly, and Lifetime options unlock premium hosted summaries, PDF and supported social-video processing, Deep Sumr visual analysis, and follow-up features. A separate Follow Ups purchase permanently unlocks questions and custom prompts for bring-your-own-key users. Eligible purchases support Family Sharing.

BUILT FOR APPLE DEVICES

Your summaries and settings sync with iCloud across iPhone and iPad, with support for Apple silicon Macs. Sumr is designed to stay out of the way until you need it.

PRIVACY

Bring-your-own-key summarization goes directly to your selected provider. Subscriber requests are processed and immediately discarded. Summaries are saved in the app and sync through iCloud.
